(5) BUDGET: projected ~450s (2x iter-1 train + same val + figure) << 20 min (30-min sbatch wall). (6) Loop continues; iter-3 dispatched on landing. If hr plateaus/drops, epochs is not the lever -> pivot to capacity (unet_c) at iter-3.
